functions.name: Car_UpdateSuspensionPass

functions.name: Car_SolveUpright
functions.description: d flips the lock flag (0xbe4, 0xbdc, 0xbe0) after 100 frames. Timers 0xba0/0xba4/0xba8 hold the "just spun out" state of each axis and clear once the two remaining angular components grow past 0xf5c. When an axis is unlocked and unflipped, the angular velocity is projected off the normal in body space and damped. The three axes are then re-orthonormalized (right, and up/forward rebuilt from it) and, when any axis flipped, the deepest corner against the normal is pushed to the deformation solver.

functions.name: FUN_0040a980

functions.name: Particle_UpdateAll

functions.name: CSound::FUN_004a28d0

functions.name: FUN_004b21e0

functions.name: Sector_BuildCorners

functions.name: Sprite_FillRect

Kept as FUNCTION on

functions.name: FUN_004aac40

functions.name: Font_GetTextWidth

functions.name: FUN_00469100
functions.description: Averages (16.16) the per-object distance between every stage object's float vertex data and its fixed-point copy, skipping parts 1 and 3 when the record flag is set (their object count still feeds the divisor).

functions.description: builder (-1 none). Emits the shadow mesh of a scene node: transforms the light direction and basis by the node matrix, projects every vertex of the mesh, then walks the faces: a face whose three vertices are behind the light plane is dropped, and the vertices of the others are emitted once with their lit position and their colour, sharing the emitted vertex of duplicated vertices. the call order follow the original); the diff is the register allocation and the FPU scheduling of the vertex loop.

functions.name: FUN_0046ec40

functions.name: Sector_NearestCornerHeight

functions.name: FUN_0047ca30

functions.name: FUN_004d6870

functions.name: FUN_004a4b10

functions.name: FUN_0048cc30
functions.description: Per-frame update of a trackside camera: eases its zoom and shake settings towards the spot's near/far values once the car is in range.

functions.name: FUN_004d7750
functions.description: Draws the car setup screen: one banner per item with the value of the selected column, plus the highlight bars.

functions.name: FUN_005091c0
functions.description: Normalises a vector and flips it when it points down. Builds the preview node's transform from the four corner heights stored in the option record (field_0x22c): the up axis is the sum of the two edge normals, the other axes come from Gram-Schmidt and the position from the average height.

functions.name: FUN_0047b0e0
functions.description: Refreshes the on-screen control indicators of the active car (steer, throttle, brake, handbrake) from the input device driving a player: analogue axes scale the indicators, digital buttons light them full.

functions.name: FUN_0046d2d0
functions.description: Loads a replay buffer and validates its recorded dimensions.

functions.description: Shuffles the RGBA bytes stored for one triangle vertex into the D3D ARGB layout expected by the vertex buffer. Re-writes the vertex colours of the locked copy of the vertex array (shuffling the stored RGBA bytes into the D3D ARGB layout) and uploads the whole array into the mesh's shared vertex buffer.

functions.name: FUN_005034f0
functions.description: Copies one group of fields of a rally data record into the working option record of the given index and adds the group's weight to its value; clears the group's "already applied" flag.

functions.name: FUN_0047f740

See FUN_0047eab0 for the record layout. residual is MSVC's register allocation, stack-slot placement (the original spills the spark Y to [ebp-0x44] and keeps the frame at 0x48) and its choice of cursor/induction-variable base (0x4b0 vs 0x4b8) in the 18-spark loop.

functions.name: FUN_0046cfa0
functions.description: Plays back one frame of a replay stream: at the start of a section it restores the recorded car state, then feeds the recorded controls and picks up the camera event of the current frame. Ends the replay after the last section.

functions.name: FUN_004b93c0
functions.description: Relocates the stage mesh file: turns the offsets stored in the node, mesh, object and sector records into pointers, registers them in the scene node, mesh, stage object and sector tables, loads the textures and re-uploads the vertex buffers of every mesh.

functions.name: FUN_00484e00

functions.name: FUN_0047d330

functions.name: StageObject_UpdateSkidTrails

functions.name: FUN_0044bcd0

functions.name: FUN_004e1d70

functions.name: StageUI_ApplySoundState

Renaming/reordering the locals, folding the intermediates into the expressions do not move MSVC 6's choice (same ceiling as FUN_004b4490 / FUN_004b4180).

functions.name: FUN_0048e730

functions.name: FUN_00471950

functions.name: Mesh_BuildParts

functions.name: FUN_0046ea80

functions.name: GlassShard_Draw

review.remaining: Matching pendiente. Los fixtures prueban la inicialización y sus consultas reales, no toda la simulación de contactos físicos.

review.finding: Defectos confirmados frente al original: la consulta de tiempo sobrescribía y perdía el puntero a jugadores; una salida pasaba a teardown el argumento de entrada en lugar de la fase guardada; varias salidas de los estados 0 y 4 omitían o añadían transiciones y el restore de etapas pares omitía el estado 2. Corregidos el 2026-10-03.
review.validation: differential_race_handler.py recorre todas las entradas de las cinco tablas (11/5/13/7/4), modos 0..12 y default, estados 0..4 y default, flags de teardown/resume, cero a ocho slots y etapas 0..11. review.remaining: Matching local pendiente. Teardown de etapa, replay, vistas, sonido/render y selección externa están controlados; el fixture valida el despacho y sus argumentos/orden, no las implementaciones de esos proveedores ni una carrera completa.

review.finding: Los ceros de posición se guardan desde la base del objeto y los seis campos finales conservan el orden de lectura/store del original. La búsqueda consigue bytes locales exactos desde el 94%.
review.validation: 6144 entradas directas adicionales con el mismo modelo afín independiente, modos de split, consultas reales de juego/carrera y guardas. También se ejecuta dentro de las 6144 reconstrucciones de 0x486910. Todos los helpers son reales; sin proveedores simulados.
review.remaining: Los fixtures no representan todo el ciclo de objetos o una etapa interactiva. Las dos versiones anteriores también pasan estos casos.
